arms.shared: Original native shared actor and critic
arms.moe: Four expert residuals, two active, original architecture
arms.moe8: Eight of the same residual experts, two active
arms.moe1: Four residual experts, one active. Unit forward weight with straight-through selected full-softmax probability for router gradients.

continuation: Recreate the original 65,536 decisions from BC, require exact equality with every archived shared and MoE parameter/buffer, then continue uninterrupted for 196,608 additional decisions per run.
training: Original four balanced streams, 256-decision updates, Adam carries through 65k, PPO settings and outcome-only reward unchanged. Frozen BC team preview for each side.
evaluation: Same 16 games and simulator/action seeds per pair, frozen BC opponent, familiar x familiar, familiar x unseen, unseen x unseen in both directions. Primary held-out win rate weights the two directions equally.
routing: Main test is normal routing minus the same cyclic frozen expert-identity permutation as at 65k on held-out teams. Compare that paired effect at 262k and 65k. Also zero expert residuals at evaluation to distinguish collective expert contribution from expert identity.
capacity: Compare 4/top-2 with 8/top-2 at both budgets holding active count fixed. Compare 4/top-2 with 4/top-1 to test active count at fixed bank size; the top-1 router uses a straight-through gradient.
uncertainty: Paired 6,000-draw crossed percentile bootstrap over training seeds, roster axes and game seeds within simulator seat.
